title: elaphoglossum viride
intro: Elaphoglossum viride, commonly known as the green elaphoglossum, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. The health benefits of E. viride include its potential to reduce inflammation and oxidative stress, which can help alleviate symptoms of various diseases such as arthritis and diabetes. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
